title: Names for the new HR system
prompt: The new HR system uses shorter column names, doesn't take salaries and needs a pay band. Write `solve(employees)` so it returns the employees table in that shape.
rules: Rename `employee_id` to `emp_id`, `department_id` to `dept_id` and `manager_id` to `reports_to`, each in its place.
Remove `salary`. Keep every other column in its place.
Add `band` at the end: `level` times 10. A missing level gives a missing band.
hints: `withColumnsRenamed` takes a dict of old name to new name.
A misspelt old name is ignored without an error, so check the result's columns.
